reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthActionCategory predicate for every action, but detects #fixed with a hand-written LIKE instead of the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser.

duplication.why: The category query with the notes join and the #fixed CASE expression is pasted into getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg (five more copies of the same selection SQL).

placement.why: The decision predicate is shared in actions.ts, but the data it needs (#fixed, goal_def) is computed in SQL repeated per action rather than in one shared query.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions and the new action, with some unformatted signature lines.

maintainability.why: Any change to how #fixed or eligibility data is read must be repeated across six SQL strings, and copyPreviousMonth silently lacks the includeHiddenCategories option.

bypasses_abstraction.where: #fixed detection uses SQL LIKE instead of shared/tags extractTagsFromText; copyPreviousMonth does not expose includeHiddenCategories

disguised_duplication.where: the category-selection SQL is repeated with small variations in column lists and typing (c.* vs explicit columns, MonthActionCategory vs DbViewCategoryWithGroupHidden) across getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthActionCategory gains includeHiddenCategories (renamed from includeHidden) and new group_fixed and goal_def conditions; copyPreviousMonth calls it without the hidden option
